name: @phys0/electron
description: Local LeRobot experiment console backed by phys-0.

scripts.build: npm --prefix ../../.. run backend:build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run prepare-native-name && ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron --no-sandbox .
scripts.watch: npm run build && npm run prepare-native-name && concurrently -k -n tsc,copy,app -c blue,magenta,green "tsc -p tsconfig.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "chokidar 'src/renderer/*.{html,css}' -c 'node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs'" "ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electronmon --no-sandbox ."
